articles.title: Why Are Tarot Readers Asking Robots for Advice?
articles.summary: More people are using AI chatbots to help read tarot cards. A new study talked to 12 tarot readers who use AI, even though the robot doesn't know their life story. Some say it helps them skip the hard part of figuring out what the cards mean.

articles.title: A Bus Ride to Fight for Voting Rights, Just Like 60 Years Ago
articles.summary: People rode buses from Atlanta to Montgomery, Alabama, to protest a new Supreme Court ruling that makes it harder for Black voters to elect their chosen leaders. The rally was led by Fair Fight Action, and one rider, 62-year-old Keith Odom, said he came for his grandchildren's future.

articles.title: Why Does the UK Keep Changing Prime Ministers?
articles.summary: The UK has had five prime ministers in seven years. Experts say it's because of big problems like Brexit and COVID-19, but also because leaders lack skills and social media makes people impatient. Prime Minister Keir Starmer says the country is not ungovernable.
